Name: Black Jacket Abigail
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
Does what it says on the tin, simply turns Abigail's clothes black.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url].

Unzip the Portraits into the Portraits/Abigail folder there. Only choose one set from the Sleeves or No Sleeves folders.
